generator: Hand-drawn flat emblem rendered programmatically with Python Pillow (supersampled polygons, Lanczos downscale). No AI image generation, no photograph traced.
motif: Two white wind turbines on a navy ridge for the Pililla Wind Farm (Brgy. Halayhayin, Pililla, Rizal), golden eight-ray Philippine sun, cobalt and pale-blue waves for Laguna de Bay. Circular badge on transparent exterior background.
license: Original community artwork for Better Pililla; reuse under CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Replaces the former template emblem, which depicted a waterfall from another municipality. This is a community emblem, not the official municipal seal of Pililla and not a documentary image. Header and favicon are Lanczos-resized derivatives.
